description: Admin invite codes for public signup: list, create, update, top-up, delete.

not_applicable.raw_protocol: Plain JSON request/response; no ranges, redirects, multipart, or upgrades.

scenarios.description: Lists every invite code: 200 JSON array.
All three seeded codes appear with use counts and the enabled flag; the exhausted one has use_count == max_uses.
Every row has exactly the nine fields; no nulls.
Newest first by created_at; ids unique.
An admin acting through a non-primary profile is refused: admin powers need the primary profile.

body.value: Admin access requires the account's primary profile

scenarios.description: Creating a code answers 201 with the code.

scenarios.description: Updating a code answers 204 with no body.
Only supplied fields change; an empty body is a no-op that still answers 204 for an existing code.
enabled=false disables the code.
Unknown id is 404.
Non-integer id is 400.
Non-JSON body is 400.
No body on success (unlike top-up, which returns the code).
scenarios.notes: PUT returns 204 while POST top-up returns 200 with the row; inconsistent within the group. Flagged for the section PR.
